notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Treasures.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing all Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassins in addition to their other types.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When the Treasures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers five times, creating five Treasure tokens.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
